messages:
alex: Quick checkpoint — console observability roadmap. Need owners for the remaining pieces before next milestone (Wed). Short list: dashboard for slow tail, tracing hooks for retention sampling, error-analysis grouped view, retention change for traces/logs.

maya: I can take the slow-tail dashboard. Will draft panels + KQL queries. Target PR by Tue EOD.

liam: I can own tracing hooks + sampling config. Question — do we increase trace retention to 90d or add tiered retention? Storage tradeoff.

rebecca: Data team can provide aggregated 1h metrics and cardinality estimates. I need the event schema (fields) — @alex can you post the field list?

alex: field list posted in docs link: https://redwood.internal/obs/schema (also pasted below)

alex: Fields: trace_id, span_id, service, op, latency_ms, error_code, env, user_id, endpoint_path

sam: For error-analysis grouped view I can assemble initial grouping by (service, error_code, endpoint_path). Need signal thresholds — suggest p95 error rate > 0.5%

maya: PR for dashboard will be 7892 — ping @sam and @liam for review when ready.

liam: For retention, propose tiered approach: hot 30d full spans, warm 90d aggregated spans (no payload). Config snippet:
```
traces:
  hot_retention_days: 30
  warm_retention_days: 90
  warm_aggregation: true
```

rebecca: Warm aggregation ok, but we need to define aggregation keys. I'll send a small schema proposal by EOD.

alex: Ownership summary: dashboard -> maya, tracing hooks -> liam, error view -> sam, data metrics -> rebecca. I'll update the roadmap board.

maya: Quick Q — who will do canary on console? ops runbook? @devops-bot shows last deploy 1867480000

sam: I'll own canary. Plan: 10% routes for 24h, monitor latency and error spikes. If > p99 +30% rollback.

liam: FYI there's a dependent infra PR 4563 for storage config. Blocker until it's merged.

rebecca: We'll need that merged before aggregation runs. I'll block on 4563 in my ticket.

alex: Action items: maya PR 7892, liam PR for hooks & 4563 merge, sam canary plan doc, rebecca aggregation schema. Backfill owners on board by EOD. Thx :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging -> 1867510300. Canaries enabled.

maya: ack, will aim for Tue PR.

sam: I'll post canary runbook link once drafted.

liam: tagging infra team: @infra-leads — need urgent review on 4563.

rebecca: I'll DM infra with cardinality numbers.

alex: thanks all, will reconvene async if blockers. If anyone needs to shift ownership ping here.
